content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]

content.problemStatement:
Solve a given equation and output the value of `'x'` in the form of a string `"x=#value"`. The equation includes only `'+'`, `'-'` operation, the variable `'x'` and its coefficient. You should output `"No solution"` if there is no solution for the equation, or `"Infinite solutions"` if there are infinite solutions for the equation.

If there is exactly one solution for the equation, we ensure that the value of `'x'` is an integer.

**Example 1:**

```
Input: equation = "x+5-3+x=6+x-2"
Output: "x=2"
```

**Example 2:**

```
Input: equation = "x=x"
Output: "Infinite solutions"
```

**Example 3:**

```
Input: equation = "2x=x"
Output: "x=0"
```

**Constraints:**

* `3 <= equation.length <= 1000`
* `equation` has exactly one `'='`.
* `equation` is composed of integers with an absolute value in the range `[0, 100]` without any leading zeros, and the variable `'x'`.
* The input is generated that if there is a single solution, it will be an integer.

notes: Expected output is the JSON-serialised string returned by solveEquation.

solution.approach: Scan the equation once, accumulating signed coefficients of x and signed constants. Move all terms to one side and classify the resulting linear equation.

better.complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
better.description: Parse each side into an x coefficient and constant, then solve the resulting linear equation.

optimal.complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
optimal.description: Use one left-to-right scan with a side sign. Accumulate A*x+B=0 and return the unique solution, No solution, or Infinite solutions according to A and B.

bruteForce.complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
bruteForce.description: Simplify the equation by parsing every term; numeric brute force is unnecessary because x is not bounded.

code.C++: class Solution{public:string solveEquation(string e){long long a=0,b=0;int side=1,i=0;while(i<(int)e.size()){if(e[i]=='='){side=-1;i++;continue;}int sg=1;if(e[i]=='+')i++;else if(e[i]=='-'){sg=-1;i++;}int st=i;while(i<(int)e.size()&&isdigit((unsigned char)e[i]))i++;long long v=(st==i?1:stoll(e.substr(st,i-st)));if(i<(int)e.size()&&e[i]=='x'){a+=(long long)side*sg*v;i++;}else b+=(long long)side*sg*v;}if(a==0)return b==0?"Infinite solutions":"No solution";return "x="+to_string(-b/a);}};
code.Java: class Solution{public String solveEquation(String e){long a=0,b=0;int side=1,i=0;while(i<e.length()){if(e.charAt(i)=='='){side=-1;i++;continue;}int sg=1;if(e.charAt(i)=='+')i++;else if(e.charAt(i)=='-'){sg=-1;i++;}int st=i;while(i<e.length()&&Character.isDigit(e.charAt(i)))i++;String n=e.substring(st,i);if(i<e.length()&&e.charAt(i)=='x'){a+=(long)side*sg*(n.isEmpty()?1:Integer.parseInt(n));i++;}else b+=(long)side*sg*Integer.parseInt(n);}if(a==0)return b==0?"Infinite solutions":"No solution";return "x="+(-b/a);}}
